summary: Flag-word mutation with a timer restart. Replaces this[1] (this+0x4) with (this[1] & 0xFFFE0FFF) | 0x2000 (mask off a flag region, set one flag), then restarts a timer through TimerStartViaQueryPerformanceCounter using this[0]. Returns the timer-start result.

operations.description: this[1] (this+0x4) = (this[1] & 0xFFFE0FFF) | 0x2000: AND-mask 0xFFFE0FFF clears a flag region, then OR 0x2000 sets a flag bit; other bits preserved.
Return TimerStartViaQueryPerformanceCounter(*this): restart the timer associated with this[0] and return its result.
Return the value produced by the timer-start call.

unresolved: TimerStartViaQueryPerformanceCounter is referenced only by name in the raw source; it is absent from the packet callees, so its identity/location is unverified here.
Meaning of the bit 0x2000 flag (and the region cleared by mask 0xFFFE0FFF) in this flag word is unknown.
